title: DS_Store metadata files
whyItMatters: A .DS_Store records folder view settings and names of items that may have been removed. It can reveal directory contents long after files are gone.
source: SWGDE macOS tech notes 13-F-002-2.0 list DS Store activity as a macOS user-activity artifact
notes: Home-folder walk capped at 5000 entries. Only files named .DS_Store are counted; reparse points, other users and other volumes are excluded by the path jail.
